overview.description: The Innovator International Developed Power Buffer ETF August (IAUG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to participate in the price movement of iShares MSCI EAFE ETF (ticker: EFA), up to a predetermined cap, while buffering the first 15% of losses over a one-year period starting August 1. The actively managed fund utilizes FLEX options and collateral IAUG was launched on Aug 1, 2024 and is issued by Innovator.
